gen-dafont-starborn-gf-atkinson-hyperleg: Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono has clipped capitals and counters that breathe. Starborn earns its place when the words are few and the size is big, its wide letter gaps and dark lowercase stripe turning dreamy.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-blinker: Blinker draws clean, open-mouthed letters that fill most of the line height. Blinker would crowd out Starborn if the heading shrank, since that wide-gapped display face needs size to hold its ground.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Wide blank gaps and a dark lowercase stripe define Starborn. Starborn is best at dreamy, spaced-out display lines, while Carrois Gothic SC, a sans-serif with clear curve openings, is best at straightforward text.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-comme: Comme reads smoothly, a sans-serif with unclogged curves and generous lowercase bodies. Comme handles the text, leaving Starborn to do what it does best: dreamy, widely spaced headlines with a dark lowercase stripe.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-cossette-texte: Cossette Texte reads wide-eyed and clean, a sans-serif with a prominent x-height. Starborn is best at dreamy, widely spaced headlines, while Cossette Texte is best at text drawn with a wire-bent look.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-duru-sans: Starborn scatters blank space between its letters, then stacks a dark lowercase stripe. Duru Sans, a modern sans with wide openings on small letters, lets lines of text move along without snagging.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-fresca: Starborn leaves big blank gaps between letters and lays down a dark lowercase stripe. Fresca, a modern sans with cord-like curves and open counters, carries a long run of text without tiring the eye.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-funnel-sans: Starborn floats its dreamy letters apart, with a dark lowercase stripe running through every line. Funnel Sans, a sans-serif with a pried-open e and uniform strokes, keeps paragraphs moving smoothly.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-hind-guntur: Hind Guntur reads tall and sturdy, like stamped metal type. Starborn drifts in dreamy, wide-spaced display letters, while Hind Guntur, with rod-like uniform strokes, holds paragraphs steady line after line.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-huninn: Starborn drifts big blank gaps between its letters and runs a dark lowercase stripe through each line. But Huninn, a modern sans-serif with crisp s terminals and fat crossbars, keeps paragraphs clear and steady.
